text: I Ching ( Yi Jing) TheI Ching ( Yi Jing)the ancient Chinese Book of Changes - a profound, practical oracle that has been in continuous use for at least 3,000 years. Today it's helping more people than ever to turn on the lights and see all the dimensions and wonders of their own lives. It is the foundation of many other Chinese metaphysical study like divination, Feng Shui and so on. Our lecturers will reveal its secret with some fresh cases in our daily life, applying easy-to-understand language to translate the arcake chapters. Tao Te Ching (Dao De Jing) Likewise, TheTao Te Ching (Dao De Jing)is the foundation of Taoist health preservation. Lao-tzu, the legendary founder of Taoism, is generally regarded as the author of this 5,000 words book. It emphasis that human being should be natural, yielding, flexible and harmonious with the surroundings, like the Tao of the nature, always on the way of perusing the balance of Yin & Yang and that eventually enable us to return to the original state, of which suppose to be the source of our life energy. Chinese medicine is always the keen interest of many westerners. In our lectures , you will be introduced to know how Chinese doctor treat patients, what are the ingredients in the prescribed herbs, how to eat and rest in line with nature rules, when to apply acupuncture and scraping back, basic self-massage methods to relief our daily stress and pains.
